prompt: Create an original 90 second Indian acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: sitar, bansuri, tabla, tanpura. Style: gradually unfolding modal melody and intricate tabla. Tempo approximately 94 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A melodic piece featuring a plucked zither-like instrument with tremolo, accompanied by bowed strings and light percussion, evoking a traditional Middle Eastern or East Asian atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首旋律优美的乐曲，以拨弦古筝般的乐器为主，带有颤音，并伴有弓弦乐器和轻柔的打击乐，营造出传统中东或东亚的氛围。
